notes.title: Sandbox-Mode + Map-Editor available!
notes.content:
Hey,
It's possible from now on to use the [b]"Sandbox-Mode"[/b], which includes several experimental / testing maps as well as a 
[h1]Full Map-Editor with Steam-Workshop Support[/h1]
- so now you can create maps and share them with the whole world!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33505829/3c8058975e05cf7732034fbb0dfee7867762fde9.png[/img][b]To unlock sandbox, 5 Blue Flames are required.[/b][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33505829/3c8058975e05cf7732034fbb0dfee7867762fde9.png[/img]

In order to upload a map, you will need to create a map first and save it locally. Then you have to zip it and select your zipped map in the "Upload Map"-menu.

If you want a preview for your map (picture for the workshop), note that the file size must not exceed 1 MB, otherwise the publishing process will fail.

I also added some tweaks and some more secrets to the main game - but that's yours to find ;)

[b]I hope you like the additions and have fun with them - if something is troubling you, feel free to let me know![/b]
